name: Frost Tetteh
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Wacker and State
description:
Daulet Novak-Tetteh is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 37, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers a — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a smuggler out of Dockside, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Daulet Novak-Tetteh describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Daulet Novak-Tetteh has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "Contraband is just cargo that hasn't been properly introduced to the right people."
"Every border is a suggestion. Every checkpoint is a negotiation."
"I move things from where they are to where they need to be. The legality is your problem."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Daulet Novak-Tetteh once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Daulet Novak-Tetteh's reputation — and a price for silence
Someone is impersonating Daulet Novak-Tetteh on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Daulet Novak-Tetteh is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters. Enhanced tendons — geneware upgrade, jump height and grip strength tripled
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
old injury that flares under specific conditions
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African dominant (68.7%) with significant Southeast Asian (14.0%), Middle Eastern (11.3%), and East Asian (6.0%) ancestry. The genetic blend produces rich, complex phenotype: deep Sub-Saharan African bone structure and coloration as foundation, with Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern features softening and refining the angles, East Asian elements contributing subtle eye shape nuance.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical — muscle definition visible in forearms and shoulders from years of precise, controlled work. No excess mass. Moves like someone who has learned to inhabit minimal space.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, blunt cut — functional. Kept neat. No vanity, pure maintenance.
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with subtle golden undertones from Sub-Saharan African heritage, warmed further by Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern ancestry blend. Sun-darkened from waterfront exposure, creating depth in coloration.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, angular face with strong, high cheekbones characteristic of Sub-Saharan African ancestry, refined by Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern features into elegant proportions. Weathered around the eyes from six years of squinting at contracts and horizon. Skin shows minor sun damage and one thin scar through left eyebrow (pale, old). Expression deliberately neutral — a mask worn so long it's become the face.
physical_description.eye_color_note: Natural deep brown with subtle warmth from ancestral blend
distinguishing_marks: Thin horizontal scar through left eyebrow, approximately 3cm, pale and well-healed
Burn scar on right forearm, size of a thumbprint, dark and slightly raised — chemical burn from early cargo mishap
Faint tattoo on left wrist: a single vertical line with three horizontal marks crossing it — personal code, meaning unknown to outsiders
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cyberears: polished titanium and black polymer construction replacing biological ears, with visible directional microphone arrays and silver accent tuning ports. No attempt to hide them — they're part of his professional toolkit. Enhanced tendons visible as faint seams of darker skin and subtle musculature definition in forearms and calves, particularly around the Achilles tendons — geneware upgrade markers subtle but present to those who know where to look.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, never fully committed to one leg. Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Hands stay visible and controlled when speaking to others. Head movements precise and deliberate, often angling to use directional microphone pickup. The way he occupies space suggests someone constantly measuring distances and angles.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical: dark, neutral colors — charcoal, black, deep gray. Reinforced cargo pants with multiple sealed pockets (for secure storage of contracts and dataflakes). Matte black synth-leather jacket, worn but well-maintained, fitted close to the body. No logos or corporate affiliations visible. Subdermal armor plating under left shoulder, detectable only as subtle rigidity under fabric. Nondescript mid-tier boots with reinforced soles for dock work. Everything is functional, everything communicates: 'I know what I'm doing and I don't need to tell you about it.'
